name: @gugacarbo/skill-task-completion-notifier
description: Development tooling for the task-completion-notifier skill.

scripts.test: bash -lc 'for test_script in tests/*.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done'
scripts.build: bash -lc 'for file in scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$file"; done' && python3 -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(path.read_text()) for path in pathlib.Path('scripts').rglob('*.py')]"
